deadline.value: December 1 application deadline for Fall PhD admission.

gre_general.value: GRE general test is optional for PhD applicants.
gre_general.quote: While the GRE General Test is optional for many programs, applicants are still encouraged to submit valid GRE scores if a test has already been taken or can take the test and provide results by our application deadline, as it gives us additional information when evaluating an application.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in this field.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study and help departments evaluate applicants' readiness for graduate school.

supervisor.value: Not stated on program admission pages.

funding.value: PhD students at WashU receive full tuition remission and a monthly stipend for living expenses for the duration of their program.
funding.quote: PhD students at WashU receive full tuition remission and a monthly stipend for living expenses for the duration of their program length.

entry_route.value: Eligible applicants must have earned or will have earned an undergraduate degree by the start of their graduate program.
entry_route.quote: All eligible applicants must have earned or will have earned an undergraduate degree by the start of their graduate program.
